01 Stears · Elections 2023 Content & organic growth
stears.co/elections

How a new election tracker beat the BBC on Google

My role
Led the SEO and content strategy. Trained economists to publish for search and coordinated editorial, engineering, data and design.
What we made
10,000+ programmatic candidate profiles, the largest digital repository of election candidate data in Nigeria, plus a live results blog and plain-language answers to voters’ questions.
Result
#1 above the BBC, CNN and INEC. 1.9M+ users, 52% from search.
02 RemotePass × Certn · 2024 Launches & go-to-market
Media pickups 270+ in the weeks after a $5.5M raise

The partnership launch that went global

My role
Ran go-to-market end to end, positioning the integration as proof RemotePass was ready for enterprise buyers.
What we made
The launch narrative and timing with Certn’s global team, the press push, and sales enablement.
Result
270+ pickups including Yahoo Finance, Fox and NBC, and enterprise conversations in regulated industries like fintech and healthtech.
03 RemotePass · Ask AI Launches & go-to-market

Everyone was selling AI. We sold the answer.

My role
Led the launch campaign for Ask AI, RemotePass’s newest feature, at the peak of the AI craze.
The angle
HR leaders told us they never had time to explore their workforce data. So the story was how easy it is to simply ask it a question, carried from the landing page to the launch video to sales enablement.
Result
Record MQL performance, and a sales team flooded with enquiries about the product.
See the case →
04 Xofu · 2026 Positioning & messaging

“Does AI recommend us?”

The one buyer question I rebuilt an AI visibility platform’s story around.

Giving a new AI product one clear question to answer

The short version

I was meant to be a lawyer.

In 2018, in a law lecture I barely remember, a friend told me about freelance writing. I wrote my way into strategy, then into marketing for some of Africa’s most watched startups, then for teams around the world. Good ideas, it turns out, really do go places.

Along the way I kept opening doors for others: Digivention, a career conference for 1,000+ young Nigerians; Write to Win, for freelance writers; and Wednesday Goodness, a career newsletter read by 900+ people. EmpowerQ is where that became a mission.

  1. 2018 A law lecture, a friend, a first freelance writing job
  2. 2020 Digivention, a career conference for 1,000+ young Nigerians
  3. 2021 Strategy at VEC Studio for SEON and Kittl
  4. 2022 PiggyVest, and Condia’s 2nd most-read article of the year
  5. 2023 Stears ranks above the BBC
  6. 2024 RemotePass: the Certn launch and a content engine
  7. 2025 Co-founded EmpowerQ
  8. 2026 Nigeria’s first State of AI Search report; Social Shifters finalist

The work I care about mostFinalist · Social Shifters Global Innovation Challenge 2026

EmpowerQ

Every queer Nigerian professional deserves a fair shot at a good career.

Many LGBTQ+ Nigerians are shut out of the networks, mentorship and fair hiring that careers depend on. I co-founded EmpowerQ in 2025 to change that, with practical support, honest research and a community that makes work safer.

  1. Lavender LadderAn employment programme built for progression, not just placement. A 2026 Social Shifters finalist.
  2. Workforce Pulse ReportResearch on LGBTQ+ working life in Nigeria.
  3. EmpowerQ DebriefA weekly newsletter on work, money and opportunity.
  4. Your Career BestieAn AI career coach. Launching soon.
  5. Out of OfficeGatherings for queer professionals.
